descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi assumerti la responsabilità di un'applicazione web all'avanguardia per la registrazione di tempo e prestazioni – una soluzione che viene utilizzata ogni giorno da circa 4.000 dipendenti in una vasta gamma di settori in Svizzera e ha un impatto reale? Qui avete l'opportunità non solo di operare un sistema, ma anche di svilupparlo attivamente, di ottimizzare i processi e di plasmare in modo decisivo il futuro della registrazione del tempo e delle prestazioni nella regione D-A-CH. Vuoi fare più che puro funzionamento del sistema? Con noi, si modella attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro sistema di registrazione del tempo e delle prestazioni e accompagnare i cambiamenti nei moderni processi HR e business dall'idea all'implementazione.
• Competenza nella registrazione del tempo e delle prestazioni: Siate il punto centrale di contatto per i nostri dipendenti nella regione D-A-CH, soprattutto in Svizzera, per domande impegnative relative alla nostra applicazione TEMPUS. Capite le esigenze dei nostri utenti, consigliate le aree specialistiche e sviluppate soluzioni pratiche insieme a loro

• Sviluppo tecnologico: ottimizzazioni e nuove funzionalità, insieme ai nostri sviluppatori, ingegneri di sistema e consulenti SAP. Potrai accompagnare i requisiti dal concepimento attraverso la fase di test con gli utenti alla riuscita introduzione di nuove soluzioni sostenibili.
• Interfaccia tra business e IT: Si agisce come un collegamento tra reparti e team di sviluppo, tradurre i requisiti tecnici in soluzioni di sistema implementabili e garantire un funzionamento stabile (2 ° livello di supporto) e correggere l'integrazione dei dati nel nostro sistema SAP. • Forte comunicazione all'interfaccia tra business e IT
• Prima esperienza professionale in una posizione paragonabile nell'ambiente IT
• Uno stile di lavoro indipendente e orientato al servizio con un alto livello di responsabilità personale
• Conoscenza fluida della conoscenza tedesca e di base dell'inglese
• Studi completi (HF/FH/uni) in informatica (business) o una qualifica comparabile di vantaggio

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you want to take responsibility for a state-of-the-art web application for time and performance recording – a solution that is used daily by around 4,000 employees in a wide range of industries in Switzerland and has a real impact? Here you have the opportunity not only to operate a system, but also to actively develop it, to optimize processes and to decisively shape the future of time and performance recording in the D-A-CH region. Do you want to do more than pure system operation? With us, you actively shape the further development of our time and performance recording system and accompany changes in modern HR and business processes from idea to implementation.
• Expertise in time and performance recording: Be the central point of contact for our employees in the D-A-CH region, especially in Switzerland, for challenging questions relating to our application TEMPUS.You understand the needs of our users, advise the specialist areas and develop practical solutions together with them
• Control and prioritize requirements: You take requirements and optimization requests from the business, analyze and prioritize them together with the relevant stakeholders and convert them into clearly defined specifications for our DEVOPS queue.
• International project environment: Active in the program for the further development and rollout of TEMPUS in the entire D-A-CH region. You bring in the requirements of our users and work in an international environment with occasional travel within Europe.
• Technological development: Drive optimizations and new functionalities together with our developers, system engineers and SAP consultants. You will accompany requirements from the conception through the test phase with the users to the successful introduction of new, sustainable solutions.
• Interface between business and IT: You act as a link between departments and development teams, translate technical requirements into implementable system solutions and ensure stable operation (2nd level support) and correct data integration into our SAP system landscape. This makes it easier for you to get started successfully, you ideally bring the following profile:
• Strong communication at the interface between business and IT
• First professional experience in a comparable position in the IT environment
• A service-oriented and independent working style with a high level of personal responsibility
• Fluent knowledge of German and basic knowledge of English
• Completed studies (HF/FH/uni) in (business) computer science or a comparable qualification of advantage
• First knowledge of HR processes is a plus
• With us, you will find a wide-ranging and challenging job with great scope for action in a successful company that is one of the industry leaders.
• Structured and careful training is a matter of course for us – your successful start is important to us.
• You can make a difference – you benefit from the exchange with committed colleagues and the strong team spirit.
• We honor your contribution – by participating in the company’s success through employee shares and success participation
• We build on common values and live them in everyday life
• With us, you will experience the best of two worlds: the diverse possibilities of a global group combined with the advantages of an agile SME.
• Our experienced leaders accompany you appreciatively on your way and create a professional environment for your personal development.
• You are important to us - we offer you an open, appreciative and family environment Still questions? Your future manager, Manager Apps & Integration DACH, Raphael Köppel has the answers and is looking forward to contacting you at +41 44 947 77 85 or raphael.koeppel@vinci-energies.com (for questions only; no applications). Did we convince you? Then apply to us today. Is this job not right for you? Further current and exciting job offers at ETAVIS/VINCI can be found here . VINCI Energies Switzerland is shaping the energy and digital future of Switzerland with the brands ETAVIS, Actemium and Axians. With comprehensive solutions in the areas of building technology, industry, energy infrastructures and ICT, the company accompanies its customers along the entire life cycle of plants and systems – from planning to implementation to operation, service and optimization. With the brands ETAVIS, Actemium and Axians and more than 4,000 employees at more than 70 locations, VINCI Energies Switzerland supports customers in all regions of Switzerland in the energy transition and digital transformation.

• Kundenberatung

• Du bist uns wichtig - wir bieten dir ein offenes, wertschätzendes und familiäres Umfeld.

• Wir beteiligen dich an unserem Erfolg – mit 5 Wochen Ferien und Boni.

• Kompetente Führungskräfte sorgen für spannende Projekte und funktionierende Arbeitsabläufe.

Schalte dich bei uns ein und reiche deine Bewerbung unkompliziert über das Bewerbungsformular ein. Wir sind in Aufbruchstimmung und freuen uns auf dich! Wir bieten massgeschneiderte, hochwertige Lösungen für Geschäftskunden aller Branchen und Grössen sowie individuell zugeschnittene Dienstleistungen für Privatkunden. Als Teil der VINCI-Gruppe profitieren wir von globaler Innovationskraft und sind gleichzeitig mit unseren rund 60 Geschäftsstellen lokal verankert. Als das grösste Kleinunternehmen ticken wir menschlicher und familiärer – hier zählt jede:r Einzelne. Werde Teil des ETAVIS-Teams und bewirke Grosses – in der Spitzenliga der Elektrotechnik!»
